answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the tundra bond on all of them and exposing each to the gale slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 15 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the jade audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A 389 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
